page.layout: One page of verse, one column; running head at top; page number at top left; a catchword-like signature "Ee" at lower right is a signature mark. No margin notes.

main_text.p:
O sanissime numinum Cupido,
Si infensus pariter fauénsque perdis,
Quis portus mihi spem feret salutis?
main_text.head: Ad eandem.

p.i:
Quantum delitias tuas amabam,
Odi deterius duplo, ampliúsque
Tuam nequitiam & procacitatem,
Postquam te propius Neæra noui.
At tu si penitus perire me vis,
Si vis perdite amem, & magis magisque
Totis artibus imbibam furorem,
Sis nequam magis, & magis proterua.
Nam quo nequior es, proterviórque,
Tanto impensius vror inquieto
Ventilante odio faces amoris,
Et lentas iterum ciente flammas.
Quòd si fis melior, modestiórque,
Odero minus, & minus te amabo.

main_text.head: Ad eandem.

p.i:
Risus, blanditia, procacitates,
Lusus, nequitia, facetiaque,
Ioci, delitiaeque & illecebra,
Et susspiria, & osculla, & susurri,
Et quicquid malesana corda amantum
Blandis ebria fascinat venenis,
Hinc facesite: Iam vale Neæra,
At tu Mens bona, sanitas, salúsque,
Continentia, castitas, pudórque,
Et modestia, veritásque simplex,
Fraudes acribus intuens ocellis,

page.notes: Signature "Ee" at lower right; a faded mark at the right margin and show-through are not transcribed. Some words in the first verse ("Quantum", "Odi") are uncertain in the scan, and "Ioci, delitiaeque" / "Et susspiria" readings are approximate.
